The Yeezy Gap

lines.text: Losing Yeezy helped push Adidas to its first loss in 30 years.
lines.say: Losing Yeezy helped push Adidas to its first loss in thirty years.

lines.text: Adidas ended the deal in October 2022, after the designer's antisemitic remarks.
lines.say: Adidas ended the deal in October twenty twenty-two, after the designer's antisemitic remarks.

lines.text: In 2022, Yeezy sold over €1.2 billion, about 5% of sales, our math.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-two, Yeezy sold over one point two billion euros, about five percent of sales, our math.

lines.text: By our math, its margin neared 42%, versus 3% for all Adidas.
lines.say: By our math, its margin neared forty-two percent, versus three percent for all Adidas.

lines.text: Adidas sold the leftovers instead: €750M in 2023, €650M the next year, donating part.
lines.say: Adidas sold the leftovers instead: seven hundred fifty million euros in twenty twenty-three, six hundred fifty million next year, donating part.

lines.text: Operating profit dropped from about €2 billion in 2021, then reached about €2.1 billion by 2025.
lines.say: Operating profit dropped from about two billion in twenty twenty-one, then reached about two point one billion by twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: The low point was 2023, the year of that loss.
lines.say: The low point was twenty twenty-three, the year of that loss.

lines.text: Revenue in 2025 hit a record €24.8 billion, with zero Yeezy.
lines.say: Revenue in twenty twenty-five hit a record twenty-four point eight billion, with zero Yeezy.

lines.text: So 5% of sales can swing a whole year's profit.
lines.say: So five percent of sales can swing a whole year's profit.

post.title: Adidas lost Yeezy, then its first loss in 30 years
post.ig:
Losing Yeezy helped push Adidas to its first loss in about 30 years.
Adidas ended the deal in October 2022. Yeezy sold over €1.2B in 2022, about 5% of sales (our math).
The leftover stock sold for about €750M in 2023 and €650M in 2024, with part donated.
2023 net loss: €58M. 2025 revenue: a record €24.8B, with no Yeezy.
Sources: Adidas annual reports 2021-2025, CNBC, AP, Fortune.
News and education, not financial advice.
